planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the 7 available. To ensure high difficulty and non-redundancy, each target was assigned a unique, high-order pedagogical facet (OFF_BY_ONE, THEORETICAL_RATIONALE, ERROR_DIAGNOSIS, BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE, and ARCHITECTURAL_COMPARISON). This approach avoids simple recall and forces students to apply deep logical reasoning, trace complex state changes, and analyze edge cases inherent in binary search partitioning problems.
